findings.location: Paragraph: "...Jesus kom for å gi en remedie for vår brutthet." (third paragraph)
findings.source_quote: Jesus came to provide a remedy for our brokenness.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a more natural Norwegian rendering for 'remedy' and 'brokenness'. For example: "Jesus kom for å gi et botemiddel for vår brist" or better: "Jesus kom for å bringe helbredelse for vår sårbarhet" or "Jesus kom for å helbrede vår bristede tilstand." Keep the rest of the sentence unchanged.
findings.translation_quote: Jesus kom for å gi en remedie for vår brutthet.

findings.location: Near end: paragraph beginning "Dette er en disippelkapsserie."
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the typographical error to the intended Norwegian compound. Replace "disippelkapsserie" with "disippelskapserie" or the clearer "disippelskap-serie" to match the subtitle and idiomatic usage.
